Okay, so I'm trying to figure out which country had the least number of athletes at the 1928 Summer Olympics. I know that the Olympics were held in Amsterdam that year. I'm a bit rusty on the exact numbers, but I remember that some countries send more athletes than others. 

First, I think I need a list of countries and how many athletes each sent. Maybe I can look up the official records or reliable sources. I recall that some smaller countries might have sent very few athletes, maybe even just one or two. But I'm not sure about the exact numbers.

Wait, I think the IOC (International Olympic Committee) keeps historical records, so maybe I can find the data there. I should also consider that if multiple countries had the same smallest number, I need to pick the one that comes first alphabetically. That part is important because the question specifies it.

I'm trying to remember if any countries usually have very low numbers. For example, maybe some island nations or smaller countries might not have a large delegation. I think Liechtenstein is a small country; perhaps they sent a small team. But I'm not certain about the exact count.

I should also check if there are any countries that might have participated under different names or if there were any political issues that affected their participation numbers. For instance, some countries might have had their teams reduced or not allowed to participate due to political reasons, which could affect the numbers.

Another thing to consider is the total number of athletes. The 1928 Olympics had a certain number of participants, so knowing the total might help in identifying the smallest delegation. I think the total was in the thousands, so the smallest would be a much smaller number.

I'm also thinking about how to handle ties. If two countries have the same number of athletes, I need to list them alphabetically and pick the first one. So, I should ensure that when I'm compiling the list, I sort them alphabetically after determining the minimum number.

I wonder if there's a database or a reliable source that lists all the countries and their athlete counts for 1928. Maybe the IOC website has historical data. I should also check if any countries had unique circumstances, like only one athlete or even a team of one.

Wait, I think I remember hearing that Liechtenstein sent only one athlete to the Olympics. If that's accurate, then that would make them the country with the least number. But I should verify this to be sure. Maybe I can cross-check with another source to confirm the number.

Additionally, I should consider that some countries might have had their athletes compete under a different flag or as part of a joint team, which could complicate the count. But I think in 1928, most countries had their own delegations, so that shouldn't be an issue.

I'm also thinking about the process of data collection. Since I'm not on the internet right now, I have to rely on my memory. If I'm unsure, I might need to make an educated guess based on known small delegations. But I should aim for accuracy here.

In summary, my approach is to find the list of countries and their athlete counts for the 1928 Olympics, identify the smallest number, check for ties, and then determine the first in alphabetical order. Once I have that information, I can return the IOC country code as required.
</think>
